name: sandbroker
description: Use local secrets without ever seeing their values. The broker injects each value into your command's environment and strips it back out of the output.
_comment: No mcpServers block on purpose. There is one server per vault and the vault
list lives in /opt/sandbroker/etc/sandbroker.json, so registering them here
would duplicate that list and drift from it. Run sandbroker-register-mcp
instead: it reads the config and writes ~/.claude.json, so the registered
servers always match the vaults that actually exist.
